critical_code_review_comments: commerce_ext.py is 700+ lines and mixes 4 concerns (cart, WhatsApp, payments, template packs). Consider splitting into commerce_ext/{cart,whatsapp,payments,packs}.py for maintainability once router factory stabilises.

apply_pack seeds products idempotently by SKU prefix but never records which pack is currently applied on the tenant document, so re-applying a different pack keeps stale SKUs. Consider tracking tenant.active_pack + an optional wipe.

In cart_update (PATCH /cart/{id}/items/{sku}) filter `it['sku']!=sku or item.qty>0` will also drop OTHER skus when their qty is somehow <=0 in stored items; safer to build explicit branch: remove only if same sku and qty==0.

_do_checkout stock reservation loop is not transactional across items: partial reservations on failure are not rolled back (comment says roll back but code just re-applies $inc:0). MongoDB session/transaction (or 2-phase check) recommended.
webhooks/whatsapp accepts messages when META_APP_SECRET is empty (dev scaffold); ensure prod deployment sets META_APP_SECRET so signature check is enforced.
razorpay client is instantiated per-request; acceptable but consider lazy singleton if traffic increases.
